notes: «مولى أبي بكر بن عبد الرحمن بن الحارث…» is Sumayy's patron-line, not a link; the link is «سمى».
«أنا وأبي» inside Abu Bakr's account is his own father in the scene, not a link.
«ثم دخلنا على أم سلمة، فقالت مثل ذلك» repeats the saying from another Companion: stored as a variant group, not a route.
